=== task: cache:clean ===
task: "cache:clean" finished
task: "cache:clean" started
task: [cache:clean] if [ -d .cache/biome ]; then rm -rf .cache/biome; fi

=== task: check ===










            $sourceConfig = $candidate
            break
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $candidate -PathType Leaf) {
        }
      printf '%s' "$candidate"
      return
    "$(json_escape "$source_config")" "$includes" >"$output"
    $additionalPattern -ne $pattern) {
    $config.extends = @($sourceConfig.Replace('\', '/'))
    $includes += '!' + $additionalPattern.Replace('\', '/')
    $includes += '!' + $pattern.Replace('\', '/')
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $output -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($additionalPattern)) {
    exit 0
    fi
    foreach ($candidate in @('biome.json', 'biome.jsonc')) {
    if [[ -f "$candidate" ]]; then
    }
  done
  exit 0
  for candidate in "$@"; do
  includes+=",\"!$(json_escape "$additional_pattern")\""
  includes+=",\"!$(json_escape "$pattern")\""
  local candidate
  local value="$1"
  printf '%s' "$value"
  printf '{"extends":["%s"],"files":{"includes":[%s]}}
  printf '{"files":{"includes":[%s]}}
  rm -f "$output"
  source_config="$(discover_config biome.json biome.jsonc || true)"
  value="${value//$'
  value="${value//\"/\\\"}"
  value="${value//\\/\\\\}"
 not for current platform - ignored
# Nothing to skip: drop the overlay a previous run left behind so the
# next task falls back to the project config instead of a stale one.
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$additionalPattern = $env:BIOME_SKIP_ADDITIONAL_PATTERN
$config = [ordered]@{}
$config | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 | Set-Content -LiteralPath $output -Encoding UTF8
$config.files = [ordered]@{ includes = $includes }
$includes = @('**')
$output = $env:BIOME_SKIP_OUTPUT
$pattern = $env:BIOME_SKIP_PATTERN
$sourceConfig = $env:BIOME_SKIP_SOURCE_CONFIG
' "$includes" >"$output"
' \
'/\
POWERSHELL
additional_pattern="$BIOME_SKIP_ADDITIONAL_PATTERN"
discover_config() {
else
fi
fi
fi
fi
fi
if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($additionalPattern) -and
if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($pattern)) {
if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($sourceConfig)) {
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($pattern) -and
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($sourceConfig)) {
if [[ -n "$additional_pattern" && "$additional_pattern" != "$pattern" ]]; then
if [[ -n "$pattern" ]]; then
if [[ -n "$source_config" ]]; then
if [[ -z "$pattern" && -z "$additional_pattern" ]]; then
if [[ -z "$source_config" ]]; then
includes="\"**\""
json_escape() {
output="$BIOME_SKIP_OUTPUT"
source_config="$BIOME_SKIP_SOURCE_CONFIG"
task: "bun:_bun:unix" finished
task: "bun:_bun:unix" started
task: "bun:_bun:windows" not for current platform - ignored
task: "bun:_install:unix" started
task: "bun:_install:windows" not for current platform - ignored
task: "bun:exec" finished
task: "bun:exec" started
task: "bun:install" finished
task: "bun:install" started

task: "check" started
task: "config:skip" finished
task: "config:skip" started
task: Task "bun:_install:unix" is up to date
task: [bun:_bun:unix] bash -lc 'export BUN_INSTALL="$HOME/.bun"; export PATH="$BUN_INSTALL/bin:$PATH"; bun x biome check  . '
task: [check] echo "✅ biome passed"
task: [config:skip] pattern="$BIOME_SKIP_PATTERN"
task: [config:skip] powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command - <<'POWERSHELL'
task: status command bun_bin="$HOME/.bun/bin/bun"; if [ ! -x "$bun_bin" ]; then bun_bin="$(command -v bun 2>/dev/null)"; fi; [ -n "$bun_bin" ] && [ -x "$bun_bin" ] && { [ -z "" ] || [ "$("$bun_bin" --version)" = "" ]; } exited zero
